name: Ameba
mood: midnight control room with electric blue data ribbons
summary: A dark AI command-center style with Midnight Ink canvas, Signal Blue as the single CTA color, Arc Cyan and Halo Violet atmospheric glow, F37 Bolton light display headings, Open Sauce Sans UI/body text, IBM Plex Mono metadata, 8px max radii, hairline borders, and clean white product screenshots.

layout.model: dark atmospheric shell with radial hero glow, white product UI surfaces, hairline borders, metric cards, data badges, and restrained blue active states

elevation.gradients: radial background glow only; never on UI elements
elevation.depth: radial atmospheric glow, hairline borders, dark surfaces, and white product frames

dos: Use Midnight Ink as the canvas for hero and feature sections.
Reserve Signal Blue for the single filled CTA, active timeline bars, and key visualization state.
Set display headlines in F37 Bolton weight 300 with negative tracking.
Use 8px radius for cards and buttons and 4px for tags and images.
Use IBM Plex Mono with tracked letter spacing for data and status metadata.
Keep product surfaces white with 1px Silver Border hairlines.
Use one radial glow behind the focal element.
donts: Do not use Arc Cyan for text, buttons, or borders.
Do not set body text below 14px in Open Sauce Sans or below 11px in IBM Plex Mono.
Do not use warm hues for brand identity.
Do not fill dark cards with semi-transparent white.
Do not use gradient fills on UI elements.
